name: The Twin Fangs
source: BigWigs (BigWigsMods/BigWigs) TheVenomousAbyss/TwinFangs.lua + Icy Veins boss guide (mechanics). Timings checked 24 Oct 2026 against Lorrgs.io (boss cast timelines of the top 50 Outlaw Rogue kills per difficulty, api2.lorrgs.io): see `checked` per difficulty.
notes: Edit freely (Fight settings > Edit…). Times are seconds after the start of the mechanic's stage. Stage starts come from the guide/BigWigs where noted, otherwise from a percentage of the fight length. timesFrom: bigwigs = timeline durations read from BigWigs (only ~the first minute or two of each stage is visible there), guide = from the Icy Veins guide, assumed = my guess. 'assumed' lists effect sizes that are guesses. Not modelled: tank/healer mechanics, raid damage, Bloodlust timing. Kill lengths: the median guild kill on Warcraft Logs (difficulty `kills`); with an export, the median kill of raids at your equipped item level (`byIlvl` brackets, Warcraft Logs), extended at 1 % per item level outside them. Phase positions come from the top-50 logs (Lorrgs) and are stored as % of the kill where health-driven.

council: Two bosses with separate health (Icy Veins: they do not share health and should die together), tanked close and cleaved (Method: start on Vexhul while cleaving Ithraz, swap at 40 %). Simulated as 2 targets for the whole fight; both submerge together.
